headline: New-build housing market gains momentum in the second quarter of this year
summary: An ingatlan.com analysis says the new-build housing market reached a turning point in the first half of the year, in line with preliminary expectations. It also covers demand, supply and prices.
why: Housing construction and prices feed into household wealth, bank mortgage lending and construction-sector earnings. Hungary's property market is closely watched for its effects on the local economy.
